methodology.structural_coverage: Count a board/concept pair when a published section has >=350 trimmed characters, explicit related_concept_ids, and registered section or inherited lesson instructional source IDs. Count pairs once. This is a structural screen, not academic approval.
methodology.source_supported_instruction: A substantive section with registered provenance is counted provisionally as source-supported instruction. Every new claim also appears in the source-to-claim ledger and remains REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW; access/currentness restrictions remain visible.
methodology.exact_mapping: Count active canonical Nursing questions only when a current study-question-links row has lesson_id and section_id. Every exact relationship remains pending independent academic review.
methodology.global_coverage: Recomputed from 687 unique board_id/concept_id placement pairs in storage/board-concept-coverage.json; the B703-reported denominator 646 is not reused.
